name: decision-brief
description: Turn a task's open questions into one decision page a newcomer can answer in one pass: every short name and codename explained in a glossary, one card per question with plain-words background, a vivid real example, options with what each changes and a labelled recommendation, plus Other answers, notes, and comment threads the agent answers live; then read every answer back at once. A local page for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok Build and pi, or a claude.ai Artifact when you pick one.

defaultPrompt: Run /decision-brief:decision-brief (Claude Code) or $decision-brief (Codex) when a task has open questions for you: it puts them all on one page in plain words, answers your comments there, and reads your answers back.
